name: @compfinder/core
description: Pricing engine and pure helpers shared by the CompFinder app and the public price page.
//: No "type" field on purpose: pricing.js and soldcomps.js are CommonJS (module.exports) while the rest are ESM. Both are consumed only through a bundler that detects syntax per file, exactly as they were when they lived in apps/app/lib. No "exports" map either, so deep paths like @compfinder/core/pricing.js keep resolving straight to the file.
